profile: Lead software engineer with 7.5+ years in financial services, building backend systems, modernising applications, and delivering enterprise AI capabilities. Hands-on implementation alongside architecture reviews, performance optimisation, and guidance for teammates delivering modernisation work across teams.

roles.title: Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Leading the **phased modernisation of a Python and React infrastructure dashboard**. Reviewed the codebase, defined architectural changes, and guided implementation of a structured backend and REST APIs. Both applications are deployed on Rancher; data-pipeline and storage improvements remain ongoing.

Built and deployed a **.NET API over legal business data**, making previously inaccessible data available to other teams. Established its deployment configuration and brought the service onto Rancher.
Built a **Python financial-data API** and established a maintainable reference implementation for continued development.

Resolved a **production performance bottleneck in financial-data APIs** by restructuring LINQ queries and processing paths, reducing pod memory from 6--7 GB to about 1 GB and endpoint response time from roughly five minutes to 40 seconds.
Guide **teammates delivering modernisation work**, reviewing architectural decisions and supporting adoption of established CI and deployment practices.
Built a **shared Helm and Flux skill used by other teams for Rancher onboarding**, creating, validating, and publishing the required repositories.
Built supporting tools for **Informatica-to-Python/Prefect migration**, including code generation and persistent progress tracking.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Designed a **modular knowledge-management and RAG template** with scanned-document support, configurable ingestion, and built-in authentication. Adopted as the account standard and used for contract-field extraction; recognised in the CIO newsletter in 2026.

Built **adaptive extraction within the template** using LangGraph and vector retrieval. Returns fields with supporting evidence and focuses subsequent passes on missing fields. Supports reusable presets and on-demand schemas.
Extended enterprise knowledge to **Claude Code and Copilot CLI through MCP**, with group-based authorisation and time-limited credentials.

Brought an existing **PDF clause-extraction application into production** through codebase modernisation, environment integration, and automated deployment. Adapted OCR and model delivery to the firm's constraints. Running reliably on Rancher for about a year; recognised in the CIO newsletter.

Modernised **.NET services and onboarded React microfrontends and NestJS APIs to Rancher**, supporting the move from Windows hosting to Kubernetes. Upgraded .NET Core 3.1 services to .NET 6/8, adopted established GitLab CI templates, and resolved build and deployment issues with Helm and Flux.
Migrated Solace messaging workloads to Kubernetes and resolved reliability and deployment issues. Contributed to critical incident recovery as part of a global engineering team.

experience.subtitle: Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd
bullets: Led API design for moving legacy C# class-library features to ASP.NET Core, defining error handling and service structure while retaining compatibility with Duck Creek's insurance configuration model.

Built an email-trigger application connecting a shared mailbox to the claims workflow using Azure Logic Apps, Blob Storage, and REST APIs. Established API documentation and automated quality checks for delivery.
Configured Duck Creek Claims capabilities for property and casualty insurance workflows.

experience.subtitle: Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd
bullets: Converted C# class-library features into REST APIs and integrated them with Azure API Management using JWT bearer authentication. Built HTTP-triggered Azure Functions and APIs to transfer documents between policy and claims applications.
Developed a decompiler-based analysis tool to inspect application code and produce method and class metrics for development effort estimation.

experience.subtitle: Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd
bullets: Maintained and enhanced an insurance claims application through regular releases and upgraded ASP.NET applications. Built document extraction, migration, and verification tools for claims data and third-party storage integration.
